h1: Seagrove Beach "I Sea Stars" 120 N Ryan Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- 2 Community pools- Private boardwalk minutes to the beach- Central location to shopping and restaurants- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Days of sun-kissed bliss await at I Sea Stars in Seagrove Beach, a beautiful 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home that sleeps 14. Boasting 2,016 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, it's perfect for families and groups seeking a serene getaway. Enjoy access to 2 community pools—one conveniently located across the street—and private boardwalk beach access only a 5-minute walk away!Dark wood floors, crisp white walls, and soft furnishings define the bright, welcoming aesthetic of this 3-story coastal home. Step through the entryway to discover cozy sleeping accommodations with outdoor access and a laundry room. The spacious bunk room, ideal for kids, includes 1 twin-over-twin and 1 full-over-full bunk bed with 1 twin trundle, a TV, wall-mounted Connect 4 game, and private entrance. The lovely primary bedroom, located on the back of the house, includes a plush king bed, twin sleeper sofa, and back porch access. A collection of Adirondack chairs, a propane grill, and outdoor shower complete the yard. All the home's bedrooms feature private bathrooms!The stunning second-floor great room serves as the heart of the home, exuding warmth. Two plush sofas and matching armchairs come together to create an inviting living space, perfect for talking or watching the 55"Smart TV. The chef's kitchen, featuring high-end appliances, flows seamlessly into a quaint breakfast bar that seats 4. A farmhouse dining table with banquette seating and 3 chairs is elegantly tucked into a windowed alcove for sit-down dinners. Brew Keurig coffee and step onto the balcony for relaxing sunrise views on cushioned seating or enjoy a nightcap at the alfresco tabletop. This floor boasts a spacious guest bedroom with a king bed and a private balcony with peaceful neighborhood views.Guests who enjoy the outdoors will love the third-floor guest bedroom, which includes a comfy queen bed, TV, and elegant French doors open to a fully furnished deck. Bask in the sunshine among swaying treetops or unwind in the refreshing evening air.Discovering 30A is effortless at I Sea Stars, with on-site parking for 3 vehicles and 4 complimentary adult bikes. For beach access, follow Ryan Street south to Eastern Lake Road and take Chelsea Loop to the end of the cul-de-sac. Walton Dunes Public Beach Access boasts beach chair service and bonfires—only a 5-minute drive away at 320 Beachfront Trail. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 14):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed and Twin Sleeper Sofa, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed and Full-over-Full Bunk Bed and Twin Trundle Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.*The summer's edge beach access will not be available 1/5/26-2/5/26 due to repairs. During this time, the closest beach access available would be the Ramgate beach access.

Enjoy access to 2 community pools—one conveniently located across the street—and private boardwalk beach access only a 5-minute walk away! Dark wood floors, crisp white walls, and soft furnishings define the bright, welcoming aesthetic of this 3-story coastal home. This floor boasts a spacious guest bedroom with a king bed and a private balcony with peaceful neighborhood views. Guests who enjoy the outdoors will love the third-floor guest bedroom, which includes a comfy queen bed, TV, and elegant French doors open to a fully furnished deck. Bask in the sunshine among swaying treetops or unwind in the refreshing evening air. Discovering 30A is effortless at I Sea Stars, with on-site parking for 3 vehicles and 4 complimentary adult bikes. For beach access, follow Ryan Street south to Eastern Lake Road and take Chelsea Loop to the end of the cul-de-sac. Walton Dunes Public Beach Access boasts beach chair service and bonfires—only a 5-minute drive away at 320 Beachfront Trail. Book today!
